owner_names: Ryoji Baba; Miracle Exploration Technologies Ltd.
footnote_text: On November 17, 2026, Ryoji Baba acquired 640,000 common shares of rYojbaba Co., Ltd. from Satoshi Saito without monetary consideration. This transfer occurred as a return of common shares following a director's resignation, fulfilling the terms of Mr. Saito's agreement with rYojbaba Co., Ltd.
